source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cloud data security (PDF 160-161).

blocks.text: Hassas data door ke servers par rakhne mein breaches, ghair mujaz rasai aur data zaya hone jaise khatre hain. Providers mazboot hifazat istemal karte hain, magar users ko bhi encryption, mazboot authentication aur security policies ke baqaida jaize se, providers ke auzaar istemal kar ke, apna data bachana chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: apni istemal ki cloud services, har ek ka faida, aur apne data ki hifazat ka tareeqa likhein.
blocks.explanation: Maslan: email ke liye Gmail (mazboot password aur two-step verification se mehfooz) aur school files ke liye Google Drive (sirf chune logon se share). Har student apni services aur hifazati tadabeer likhe.

items: Cloud security: breach aur nuqsan ke khatre; encryption, mazboot authentication aur policy jaize se hifazat.
